notes.title: Unit Down Charge is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Let everyone know![/h1][p]The game is now public, which means not just crowdfunding partners can now enjoy the game!  Run, shoot, and dodge through the newest addition to the rail-shooter genre![/p][p][/p][h2]Thank you for your support![/h2][p]It really means the world to me, and your comments kept me driven to finish this project.  I hope you enjoy my lil' passion project!  I am so excited to see ya'll play Unit Down Charge![/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay Proper,
   - Randy[/i][/p]

notes.title: Early Release for Crowdfund Partners!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44397978/f678276ccf94c4e09742717762f16a57ec1e7abe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Crowdfund partners that helped bring the game to life will have access to the game [b]TODAY![/b][/h3][p]The current version will feature the [b][i]full main game[/i][/b].  This means you can enjoy the entire story from the beginning to the end!  Also includes an "Expert Mode" for those that want to see an extra challenge for some bonus points![/p][p]The full version on [b]September 26th[/b] will feature extra bonus stages separate from the story;  Simple one-off levels based loosely on content creators that have supported or influenced me over the years.[/p][p][/p][h1]Excited to see ya'll in 10 days![/h1]

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44397978/3e8c3f2da15dbb176dd09358e1c2d85160f2bca0.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Demo has been updated![/h1][p]Thanks to player feedback, the newest version now has some major changes:[/p][list][*][p]Enemy fire rates have been increased to provide more challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad support completely revamped for better control![/p][/*][*][p]Deon's ability and fire rate has been adjusted for balancing.[/p][/*][*][p]Lar's slowmo ability now increases his fire-rate as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Score staling starts decreasing max score per enemy by a slower rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses "Time Bonus" now decreases at a more competitive rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Enemy has a more obvious weakspot.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss battles have their speed increased at early stages.[/p][/*][*][p]And some minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Thank you for playing my demo and hope to see you at launch![/h2]

notes.title: Updated Demo, Release Date, and Live Stream!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44397978/13e0d3ee1d65db8d492096a2795fa78da706d2a2.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]The release date of Unit Down Charge has been set to September 26th, 2025![/h1][p]On top of that, the demo has been updated with requested changes, including player fire-rates, difficulty curve, options menu in pause, a complete overhaul of the gamepad controls, deeper optimizations, and some bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][h1]A live-stream of Unit Down Charge will be happening during the Steam Next Fest![/h1][p]I will be live-streaming the demo, and will be answering any questions (or listening to suggestions) at that time.  I am always open ears and would love to hear from you![/p][p][/p][h2]Thank you all for your support![/h2]
